name: Spider-Man: Miles Morales
description: In the next chapter of the Spider-Man universe, Miles Morales discovers explosive powers that set him apart from his mentor, Peter Parker. Master his unique bio-electric venom attacks and the spectacular camouflage ability while learning to be a hero in his own right as a new threat rises to destroy his home, New York City.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: A vast open world teeming with monsters, political intrigue, and moral dilemmas. As Geralt of Rivia, a professional monster slayer, you'll hunt beasts and search for Ciri, a young woman with the power to save the world. Features hundreds of hours of gameplay and meaningful choices that shape the narrative.

name: Elden Ring
description: From Software’s latest epic combines the challenging combat of Dark Souls with a breathtaking open world. Explore the Lands Between, a realm shattered by the Elden Ring, and battle demigods to become the Elden Lord. Unparalleled freedom in exploration and character customization.

name: God of War Ragnarök
description: The highly anticipated sequel to 2018’s God of War. Kratos and Atreus embark on a perilous journey across the Nine Realms to prevent the prophesied end of the world. Featuring brutal combat, a deep emotional story, and stunning visuals.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
description: A crime epic set in the sprawling metropolis of Los Santos. Play as three distinct characters – Franklin, Michael, and Trevor – as they pull off daring heists and navigate the criminal underworld. Includes the massive GTA Online universe for endless multiplayer fun.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Step into Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour, and body modification. Play as V, a mercenary outlaw, on a quest for a unique implant that holds the key to immortality. A deep RPG experience with branching narratives and futuristic action.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: An immersive open-world Western that tells the story of Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as they fight for survival in the fading days of the Wild West. Features a gripping narrative, stunning landscapes, and deep gameplay mechanics.

name: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Experience the Wizarding World in the 1800s. Create your own witch or wizard, attend classes at Hogwarts, learn powerful spells, and explore a vast, magical open world. Uncover an ancient secret that threatens the wizarding world.

name: Horizon Forbidden West
description: Aloy continues her journey in a stunning post-apocalyptic world where robotic creatures roam the land. Explore dangerous new territories, discover advanced technologies, and uncover the truth behind a deadly blight threatening life on Earth.

name: Resident Evil 4 (Remake)
description: A reimagined classic. Leon S. Kennedy is sent to rescue the President’s daughter from a mysterious cult in rural Europe. Experience tense survival horror, strategic combat, and a gripping story with modern graphics and gameplay.
